payload.friendly_name: Slice F: the kind taxonomy and the mission-type schema
payload.purpose_context: R18 is one of the last undecided cutover reads in epic #94, and core's scope migration moved the kind-taxonomy and mission-type schema rulings here. They change one model: which kinds exist and how a mission type's steps are authored. The charter's model is canonical, so old shapes are replaced outright and open-packs follows.
payload.purpose_tldr: Serve the kind table as data (R18), retire mission_step_contract, make steps the single mission-type authoring surface, and type each relation's endpoint kinds.

payload.question: Q1: R18 kind taxonomy: GET /offering/kinds with kinds[] and relations[] (endpoint table), no core org facts, not deferred to merge?
Q2: Retire mission_step_contract by moving delegations to scope edges, the gate to the lifecycle guard and substep text into prompts (substep structure lost until #513)?
Q3: charter.schema.json template_set (#520 template names only the kind)?
Q4: mission_type -> action edge: derive from steps and refuse an authored copy, or keep authored?
Q5: Adopt the drafted relation endpoint table (research R6)?
Q6: Retire impacts, replaces and delegates_to in this slice (widens #515), or give them endpoint rows?
Q7: #447 ownership: slice F closes it, or slice C?
Q8: Include #350 (procedure edge to action:) as a row of the endpoint table?

payload.final_answer: As proposed: GET /offering/kinds (getKindTaxonomy), kinds[] and relations[] with endpoints; no core org facts; not deferred to merge.

Fold substeps into the mission-type Step, then retire the kind. Follow-ups: flat ordered list substeps[] in the step (one level, no new relation, #513 narrowed to recursion and DECOMPOSES_INTO); all fields kept (id, description, command, inputs, delegates_to, guidance); delegates_to kept as substep data AND a scope edge from the action to every candidate is required (open-packs adds the 72 missing).
Keep the mission_type -requires-> action edge authored and complete: one per step, on-demand steps included; a pack missing one is refused at load with a named violation.
As drafted (research R6), recorded in an ADR-0064 amendment.
Retire impacts, replaces and delegates_to. Note: replaces was sometimes used to mean overrides; a replaces edge migrates to overrides.

Slice C delivers #447 (FR-014). F folds OverrideSourceRule into the endpoint rule but keeps C's violation code overrides_source_not_activatable for that fault; every other endpoint fault uses relationship_endpoint_not_allowed.
Include: F closes #350 with the endpoint table and one invalid example pack.

options: One new ADR plus amendment notes
payload.question: Where are slice F's decisions recorded: amendments to ADR-0074, ADR-0044 and ADR-0064, or one new ADR?

options: Kind marker types plus per-relation factories
payload.question: How are relationship constructors typed by endpoint kind in Java?
How does slice F land: one PR or several?

payload.final_answer: One new ADR (kind taxonomy and step authority) holding every slice F decision; touched ADRs get short notes pointing at it; number chosen against main and the open PRs when written.
Kind marker types (sealed kind groups), NodeRef<K>, per-relation static factories on Relationship; one checked bridge at the boundary applies RelationType's table.
One PR from slice-f-537-kind-taxonomy into main with ordered WPs and one Breaking fragment.

payload.question: May a substep delegate to an agent_profile (ADR-0032 d1)?
Does removing a mission type also drop its own step actions' scope edges?

payload.rationale: ADR-0032 d1: a mission type names roles, never profiles; slice G's role selection stays authoritative. Delegation targets are guidance kinds only.

Extends DM-01M7CF9PA1V2DS0P7ZZVANJ1WZ: removing a mission type also drops scope edges whose source is one of its own step action nodes (own pack, bare or own-name), so a delegating type can be deleted.

payload.question: Drop own scope edges from registered.graph.yaml on mission-type removal too?

payload.rationale: Same rule for authored and registered edges; otherwise a delegating type still answers 409.

payload.question: Name relationship_endpoint_not_allowed in the 500 pack_unreadable detail?

payload.rationale: The detail should carry the endpoint code.

payload.question: Give the unknown-relation-type 422 a violation with a code and /type pointer?

payload.rationale: The refusal should carry a violation, as other 422s do.

payload.question: How is the charter.yaml template_set refusal shown at contract level?

payload.rationale: A repository charter.yaml is that repo's activation set; test the config through the activation registration seam. If a follow-up is filed, add it to the activation epic.
